entries.f6127a4fad99b65f: Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥72,806 million for the power unit business, ¥33,490 million for the power device business, ¥7,410 million for the power system business, and ¥129 million for other, with the three businesses centered on electrical equipment products accounting for most of net sales. By region, Japan is ¥38,039 million, Indonesia is ¥16,141 million, India is ¥16,083 million, Thailand is ¥10,224 million, and Greater China is ¥8,058 million, with substantial net sales to overseas customers as well. The customers accounting for 10% or more of consolidated net sales are two companies — PT Astra Honda Motor (¥12,522 million) and Honda Motorcycle and Scooter India Private Limited (¥12,503 million) — both group companies of Honda Motor Co., Ltd.
